author: nicolas
text: This amount has to repay the balance of my mortgage in eighteen months. People keep talking to me about crypto, but I cannot reach the deadline with less than I have today.

author: nicolas
text: I am 72 and this is most of what I have saved. If it fell by even 3% I would sell everything, so I only want things that barely move.

author: nicolas
text: I am cautious by nature. Over six years, my adviser says I can put in a little equity, but I do not want to go above 25% of the total.

author: nicolas
text: In March 2020 I lost 20% and sold everything at the bottom. My horizon is five years and I do not want to go through that again: small drops yes, a big fall no.

author: nicolas
text: Goal: beat inflation by 2 or 3% a year over five years. Maximum acceptable loss over the year: 8%.

author: nicolas
text: We have two stable salaries and an emergency fund already invested separately. This money is for in eight to ten years, ideally 60% equities and 40% bonds.

author: nicolas
text: Medium term, around seven years. I could sit through a 20% fall without panicking, but I would not put everything into equities.

author: nicolas
text: I like taking risks, but this is half of my wealth and I plan to use it in six years to open a shop.

author: nicolas
text: I am a 30-year-old engineer with no debt and an emergency fund on the side. I want 100% equities for twenty-five years and I almost never look at prices.

author: nicolas
text: My tech stocks lost 40% in 2022 and I bought more. I will not touch this money for twenty years and I do not need any income from it.
